title: Coercion modes and humanized tool-call diagnostics
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Runtime and SDKs currently return low-level JSON parse/type errors for tool/function calls. These messages are noisy for application developers and make automated recovery brittle. We need a single, compatible JSON schema extension and runtime-side behavior that enables: (1) configurable coercion modes per-route and per-parameter, (2) concise machine-readable error codes and humanized messages for SDKs/console, and (3) telemetry hooks so Product and Reliability can measure common failure modes and guide optimizations.

Goals:
- Define a small, backward-compatible JSON schema extension for tool parameters (metadata fields) that specifies coercion behavior, example values, and remediation hints.
- Implement parameter validation that emits structured diagnostics with stable error codes, severity, and suggested-repair text.
- Introduce runtime "validation_event" telemetry that includes parameter path, error_code, and client-visible hint id.
- Provide SDK mappings to present friendly messages and one-click fixes (e.g., coerce types, drop unknown keys) where safe.

Non-goals: change core JSON Schema spec, remove existing server-side strict validation by default (we will pick a conservative default and provide migration guidance).
acceptance_criteria: Schema extension documented: new metadata fields 'coercion_mode', 'example', 'repair_hint' are accepted in our parameter DSL and preserved in model manifests.
Runtime supports three coercion modes: 'strict', 'coerce', and 'lenient'. Behavior documented and configurable at route and parameter levels.
Validator emits structured diagnostics for each problem with fields: 'error_code' (stable string), 'severity' (error/warn/info), 'param_path', and 'user_hint_id'.
SDK surfaces human-friendly messages mapped from 'user_hint_id' and offers programmatic helpers to attempt safe repairs (e.g., coerce_number, drop_extra_properties).
Console receives 'validation_event' telemetry for server-side failures and aggregates top error codes per model/route.
Migration guide produced showing how to opt-in/opt-out and a one-week grace window for lenient mode on hosted API routes.
Automated tests cover coercion edge cases (nested arrays, enums, nullables) and ensure backwards compatibility with legacy manifests.
tasks: Design: finalize grammar and examples for 'coercion_mode' and 'repair_hint' fields in the schema extension (doc link in comments).
Runtime: implement validation pipeline changes to read metadata, apply coercion modes, and produce structured diagnostics (error_code + user_hint_id).
SDK: map diagnostics to human messages and implement helpers for automatic repair attempts with opt-in flags.
Telemetry: define and emit 'validation_event' (param_path, error_code, severity, model, route, customer_tier).
Docs: write API/Console docs and migration guide for Hosted/Dedicated/Private deployments.
QA: add fuzz tests and property-based tests to ensure coercion does not silently mutate critical input shapes.
comments: 2025-10-02 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff meeting notes attached in Drive: design rationale and trade-offs. Decided to avoid changing upstream JSON Schema syntax; add small vendor metadata only (redwood:coercion_mode, redwood:repair_hint).

2025-10-05 - Miguel Santos: Implemented prototype validator in runtime branch feat/validation/coercion. Early benchmark shows ~3% CPU overhead for lenient mode at high QPS. Needs review on memory for large nested objects.
2025-10-06 - PM review (Jordan Lee): Recommend default for Hosted API be 'lenient' for the 7-day grace period, then switch to 'coerce' as standard; Private deployments default to 'strict'.

2025-10-08 - Design review (Priya Raman): Humanized hints should include one-line summary + example fix. Provided copydeck for common error_codes (INVALID_TYPE, MISSING_FIELD, EXTRA_FIELD, ENUM_MISMATCH).

2025-10-10 - Security (Evan Zhou): No direct security concerns but flagged potential info exposure in telemetry; recommend redaction of parameter values and only send parameter paths and hashed identifiers.

2025-10-12 - Miguel Santos: Implemented error_code mapping and SDK helper prototype in js-sdk branch. Created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/912. Need UX review for message phrasing.
